title: Welcome, Zach's classmates!
author: Zach's Dad whose also named Zach
content: Hey Zach and all your amazing classmates! 👋

First off, thank you SO much for visiting my website and playing the games! When I built this site, I never imagined it would become popular at your elementary school. Knowing that you all are enjoying Tron, Pac-Man, and Arcade Hoops brings me so much joy!

I want to take a moment to tell you how awesome it is that you're interested in computers and programming. You know what? Every app on your phone, every video game you play, every website you visit - they were all created by people who started out just like you, curious and excited to learn.
=== HOW TO USE THE SUGGEST COMMAND ===
Want to see YOUR game idea on this site? Here's how to suggest new games or features:
1. Type: suggest
2. Press Enter
3. Type your awesome idea! (Example: 'A multiplayer snake game where you can play with friends')
4. Press Enter again to submit
5. If you change your mind, just type: cancel
I read EVERY suggestion! Some of the best ideas come from creative minds like yours.
=== EXPLORE AND HAVE FUN! ===
This site has lots of hidden features. Try these commands:
- 'help' - See all available commands
- 'theme dracula' - Change the colors (try different themes!)
- 'cd books' or 'cd vinyl' - Explore my collections
- 'game tron' - Play the light cycle game
- 'game pacman' - Chase those ghosts!
- 'game basketball' - Shoot some hoops
- 'neofetch' - See cool system stats
=== KEEP EXPLORING ===

Whether you grow up to be a programmer, a scientist, an artist, a teacher, or anything else - the curiosity and problem-solving skills you're developing right now will serve you well. Never stop asking questions. Never stop trying new things. And most importantly, never stop having fun while learning!

Remember: Every expert was once a beginner. Every complex program started with someone typing their first line of code. You're already on that journey, and I'm so proud of all of you for being curious and brave enough to explore something new.
Thank you for making this project more meaningful than I ever could have imagined. It has been an absolute honor to create something that brings you joy and sparks your imagination.
Keep playing, keep learning, and keep being awesome!
- Mr. Blevins (Zach's Dad)
